notes: Corrected: the accepted alignment gave the subordinate clause's copula *be* to the subject `נֶפֶשׁ`, but rule 20 sends a construction-supplied copula to the predicate wherever a predicate morpheme stands, and rule 49 puts it on the preposition heading a prepositional predicate. *be* now joins the `בְּ`+`לֹא` unit rendered *without*.
Both marginal notes were read and set aside; the printed text governs under rule 38.
